events.title: Freddie Mercury's Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost one of music's greatest showmen. His voice still fills stadiums, even if only in our memories.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a huge shift for the Fab Four and still sounds incredible today.

events.title: John Lennon's Legacy Endures
events.blurb: John Lennon, iconic singer-songwriter of The Beatles, was tragically killed on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's message of peace and love resonates just as strongly today. Imagine that.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the life and art of David Bowie, who would have been 80. A true innovator whose influence is still heard across generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Tribute
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his impact on music and culture remains unmatched. Long live the King!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page. The man who gave us some of the most iconic guitar riffs in rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Sir Rod Stewart was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still got that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the legend that is Suggs! The voice of Madness, still bringing the house down. Our house, in the middle of our street.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop singer Paul Young was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Everytime You Go Away', his voice defined the 80s for many.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and humanitarian. We will always love her.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow was born on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! The man behind so many Take That hits and a true British pop institution.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta my dreams, get into my car... and let's celebrate a legend.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's First Ceremony: 38 Years On
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be your first inductee if you started your own Hall of Fame today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert: 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the Apple Corps rooftop in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their final public performance. Imagine seeing that from your office window!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, a true drumming and vocal legend.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant was born on this day in 1960.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British charmer, Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to villainous roles, he's still got it.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake was born on this day in 1981.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: On this tragic day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, music lost three incredible talents in one tragic moment. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley was born on this day in 1966.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the man who would never give you up, Rick Astley! Still a legend, still got those moves.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the life and legacy of Bob Marley, who would have been 82. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to inspire the world.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King was born on this day in 1942.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius whose music has soundtracked generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston's Legacy: 15 Years On
events.blurb: The iconic vocalist Whitney Houston passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, 15 years since we lost a true legend. Her music still gives us chills.

events.title: Take That's Original Split: 32 Years Ago
events.blurb: Take That famously announced their split on this day in 1995, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, the world collectively mourned as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell was born on this day in 1959.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40! From 'Red Red Wine' to 'Kingston Town', a reggae legend.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran was born on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to one of the biggest stars on the planet, Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, he's still got that magic touch.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, was born on this day in 1943.

angles.name: George Harrison 84th Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember George Harrison, who would have been 84. The Beatle who brought us 'Something' and 'My Sweet Lord'. A truly gifted musician.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still smashing guitars and microphones.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw was born on this day in 1958.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw! Still 'Wouldn't It Be Good' to hear those 80s classics on repeat.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin was born on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Chris Martin Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century young and still filling stadiums around the world.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi was born on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Jon Bon Jovi Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi! Still living on a prayer and rocking stages worldwide.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Chris Rea was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chris Rea 76th Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the distinctive voice of Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today. Still driving home for Christmas in our hearts.
